description: This Java class implements a view handler for rendering PDF and other document formats using XSL-FO in the Apache OFBiz framework. It processes view rendering requests, generates XSL-FO content, and transforms it into the final output, handling encryption and error situations.

classes.name: ScreenFopViewHandler
classes.description: A view handler class in the OFBiz framework that generates PDF and other formats from XSL-FO templates, managing rendering, encryption, and error handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view handler with the servlet context.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares the context map for rendering based on the request, response, and view configuration.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the view, converting it into PDF or other formats, handling encryption, and streaming the result to the response.

methods.name: renderError
methods.description: Handles errors during rendering by generating an error page with the message and exception details.
